classes.channel classes: contract 20.18 thresholds on the channel's share of the full-model effect

classes.answer: contract 20.20, for I - B: yes / partly / no (one channel, same sign, neither)

answer.reading: partly: both channels are identifiable and of opposite sign, but at least one is below a tenth of the effect
partly: both channels are identifiable and of opposite sign, but at least one is below a tenth of the effect

I_minus_B.reading: the two channels act in opposite directions

F_minus_B.reading: the feedback runs mainly through prices and demand

I_minus_F.reading: the two channels act in opposite directions

cell_answer_by_20_20_rule.reading: yes: two identifiable channels of opposite sign, each at least a tenth of the effect, cancel as in the 20.19 cell
